## Hypothesis

The lower-highs role reversal trigger aims to capture bearish momentum when SPY forms a descending trendline (lower highs) and breaks below prior support, flipping that level into resistance. This pattern aligns with J's observed BEARISH_REJECTION days (4/29, 5/04) and may improve edge on winner days while avoiding loser days by requiring structural confirmation.

## Mechanism

Entry: 3‑min bar closes below a descending trendline (≥2 touches) that has previously acted as support, with the trendline now acting as resistance (role reversal). Requires EMA ribbon bearish (Fast < Pivot < Slow) and ribbon spread ≥30¢. Exit: primary chart stop = close above the broken trendline + $0.50 buffer; secondary chandelier profit‑lock arms at +5% and trails 0.15 off HWM; catastrophe premium stop = −50% (Safe). Position sizing follows risk‑rules.md (3 contracts at $1K‑$2K account).
